div.div: Best for: NVMe SSDs (which power EBS) have their own internal controllers that are smarter and faster than the Linux kernel. By choosing none, you remove the CPU overhead of the kernel trying to be "helpful."

bfq gives every process a "budget" of disk time.
Best For: Multi-tenant clusters where you don't want one "noisy neighbor" pod to hog the entire disk.
